source: Overture Maps divisions 2026-10-21.0 (ODbL; OpenStreetMap contributors) + Wikidata place items (CC0)
rule: Every named Overture division (county, locality, macrohood, neighborhood, microhood; ODbL) and every Wikidata item of a place class (neighbourhood, quarter, mahalle, suburb, district, city …; CC0) inside an area window becomes an alias of that area. Wikidata is added because Overture misses well-known neighbourhoods (no "Moda" in Kadıköy). A point that falls in several windows (Moda lies in the Caferağa, Kadıköy and İstanbul windows) goes to the window whose site centre is nearest — the most specific pilot. Names that occur in two different areas, or that are shorter than 4 letters, are dropped as ambiguous.
